epic.title: C3: the work lifecycle is one thing, and it is currently three
epic.intent_and_why: An agent creates work the same way it drives work -- through the door, in one call -- and the closing advance puts the work away and says it is ready to PR.

definition_of_done: open, close and the declared dispatch each ship with a violating fixture, or are refuted with the measurement that refuted them
the corpus sweep still reports exactly 23 fault lines and the suite is green

good_enough.mandatory_quality: every guard has a VIOLATING case and an INNOCENT case; a happy-path-only test measures the mechanism, not the boundary
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: targeted tests plus the full suite, per docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md's strengthened-durable-system profile

hard_constraints: checklist_engine.py's on-disk format is not changed
the close ordering (advance, release, move spine-last, commit, report) is fixed
close never opens a PR and never removes a worktree
stage by name; never git add -A
no merge or push to main
never two crews in one worktree
fixed_decisions: launched identities remain stable: every crew is dispatched with --parent naming this Commander and an explicit --model
the worktree record lives inside the spine as a top-level origin block
open and close are two tools, never one action switch
no shell CLI adapter ships -- agents must not know about the CLI

current_wave.objective: mechanize the work lifecycle at both ends and make the dispatch checkable data
exit_criteria: all five gates integrated with an APPROVE from an independent reviewer
suite green and sweep exactly 23 at every gate boundary

issues.title: open — the lifecycle module and open_work
issues.desired_outcome: One call creates branch, worktree, work area and spine, verifies its own result, and rolls back rather than half-succeeding.
issues.useful_now: Nothing in the corpus provisions a worktree today; it is typed by hand every time.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: VIOLATING fixtures for occupied-path, active-session, late-failure rollback, and self-verify-says-no.
issues.implementation_latitude: choose internals; the frozen LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT.md sections are the boundary

issues.title: close — archive, commit, and say it is ready
issues.desired_outcome: The terminal advance moves the work area, spine last, commits by name, and reports 'ready to PR'.
issues.useful_now: Close currently rediscovers what creation did, in a hand-typed two-commit shell game.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A spine driven to terminal and released is archived spine-last, proven with a differing-basename fixture.
issues.implementation_latitude: choose internals; the frozen LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT.md sections are the boundary

issues.title: the door — spine_open and spine_close
issues.desired_outcome: The lifecycle is reachable through the MCP door, so an agent never needs the CLI.
issues.useful_now: generate_spine.py is shell-only, which the standing ruling makes a defect today.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The existing call_tool pin is unmodified and green; the lifecycle surface carries its own containment pin.
issues.implementation_latitude: choose internals; the frozen LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT.md sections are the boundary

issues.title: the dispatch is emitted, not remembered
issues.desired_outcome: A spec declares the crews a gate dispatches and the generator emits parent and model already in it.
issues.useful_now: Six sub-crews last wave named the wrong parent and carried no model, with both instructions present in the order.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A registry entry naming the wrong parent fails the injected postcondition.
issues.implementation_latitude: choose internals; the frozen LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT.md sections are the boundary

issues.title: the two carried findings
issues.desired_outcome: not_yet_written refuses a non-bool, and DESIGN_NOTE sections 4, 7 and 10 stop contradicting the code.
issues.useful_now: A TOML string 'false' currently compiles the check to None -- the gate silently loses its check.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: VIOLATING fixtures for the string forms; three INNOCENT cases for the real bools and the omitted field.
issues.implementation_latitude: choose internals; the frozen LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT.md sections are the boundary

discrepancies.affects: every Commander run in this corpus, and this run's own ability to drive GATE_PLAN.json through the engine
discrepancies.evidence: _identity_violation (mcp_spine_server.py:174) refuses any argv resolving --file off the bound spine; ~/.claude.json registers spine-epic bound to the Admiral's own spine
discrepancies.reason: This is the same unautomated class the epic exists to remove, one tier up; it is evidence for the next planning turn, not an issue to file.

discrepancies.signal: The gate-plan template's default filename is execute.json, which collides with this Commander's own spine when an Admiral names the spine execute.json.
